entities.name: 2011 Chilean Air Force CASA 212 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 2 September 2011, a CASA C-212 Aviocar military transport of the Chilean Air Force on a flight from Santiago to Robinson Crusoe Island, Chile, crashed into the sea while manoeuvring to land. All 21 passengers and crew on board were killed.
